## Doron

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/doron.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user turns a leaf or a stone from their bag into the chosen outfit and wears it in place of their armor, which goes back to the bag. Taking a piece off turns the whole outfit back into the leaf or the stone Used again with the same outfit on, it takes the outfit off The ability mode key opens the wardrobe, where the outfit is chosen

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Cooldown | 10 s (200 ticks) |
| Off cooldown | 1 s (20 ticks) |
| Pack multiplier when dealing damage | 1.65× |

</div>

## Dress Up

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/dress_up.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user turns a leaf or a stone from their bag into the chosen outfit on the ally they are looking at. The ally's own armor goes back to the ally's bag. A player must be crouching to be dressed.

## Garb Blade

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/garb_blade.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user turns a leaf or a stone from their bag into a katana, in their hand or their hotbar. Put away in the bag, in a chest, or thrown, it turns back into the leaf or the stone Used again, it turns the katana back

## Gofukuten

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/gofukuten.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user sets up a gate in front of them, for half a minute at most. Whoever walks through it and is not their enemy is dressed in the chosen outfit, with no leaf nor stone needed. Used again while the gate stands, it takes the gate down. The longer the gate stood, the shorter the cooldown
